registered_scope.prediction_reference_protocol_rho: registry_status_line: given the representation state, emit the registry status line 'Claim <id> is currently listed as <STATUS>.' (teacher-forced mean per-token log-probability of the registered continuation is the frozen surrogate)
registered_scope.present_linguistic_target: the registered status-line continuation under rho
registered_scope.current_responsibility: claim-status contract with action set {RETAIN, REOPEN, ESCALATE}; ANY_OPTIMAL_ACTION semantics; loss = 0/1 against the registered acceptable set
registered_scope.future_evidence_intervention_family: controlled exogenous registry notices supplied identically to every representation condition: RETRACT(source), EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN(source), DIRECT_REFUTATION(claim), ADMINISTRATIVE_NOTICE, RETRACT(source)+REGISTRY_ANNOTATION, RETRACT(source)+REGISTRY_FLAG_POLICY (same-fibre variant)
registered_scope.future_responsibility: same contract evaluated after the intervention
registered_scope.dormant_variable: support_source (support_set for the independent-support family; current_defeat for the P1 family)
alternate_state_channels_enumerated: residual/hidden activations (checked: Gate A, all layers)
fixed model parameters (controlled: nonce source identities, Gate D)
tool/session state (not present in this surface)
retrieval metadata (not present in this surface)
registered_scope.parametric_side_information_control: source identities are episode-local nonces (invented surname + year + registry code) that fixed parameters cannot know; claim texts are templated fictitious scientific claims

decoding.chat_template: model default; contract and state placed in a single user turn (no system role, uniform across models)
decoding.answer_format: brief reasoning (<=3 sentences) then a final line 'Answer: <ACTION>'; registered extraction = last 'Answer:' match, fallback last bare action word, else UNPARSEABLE (counted incorrect)

token_budget.rule: per (instance, arm) every R-condition is padded to the maximum unpadded token count across R0..R4: whole frozen filler lines, then single ' ignore' tokens until the count reaches the target (exact up to tokenizer merges; tolerance 4)
token_budget.filler_line: Filler line: this line is intentionally uninformative and must be ignored.

seed.protected_seed_custody: sealed file '<int>:<256-bit salt>' generated on LUNARC after both models pass GPC on the dev split; stored outside the repo at /projects/hep/fs9/users/scyiu/orion-v2-pra-llm/v2/protected_seed.sealed (mode 0600), never printed; its sha256 is the commitment above; the runner refuses to generate the protected split unless the supplied file hashes to the commitment; the file is archived in the repo only after the protected run completes (post-run reveal)

leakage_controls: identical evidence text across arms except in F3_P2_RECON where the annotation IS the control
no surface feature encodes the gold action outside the registered evidence relation
F3_P2_CANON_SF: the registry-flag policy sentence is identical across arms and applies to both arms' files (both list source A), so it carries no arm information

F1_P0.gold_future: REOPEN (direct refutation) or RETAIN (administrative notice) for both arms

F2_P1.contrast: A: R1 vs R2 on current action

F3_P2_CANON.role: provenance/retraction canonical fixture, unique current action RETAIN (PRIMARY; identical to V1; successors in distinct predictive fibres: hA's successor status line is REOPENED, hB's stays SUPPORTED)
F3_P2_CANON.gold_future: hA REOPEN vs hB RETAIN after RETRACT(A)

F3_P2_CANON_SF.role: H-EXT-4 same-successor-fibre variant of the canonical fixture (REGISTERED SECONDARY): same histories, same gold, evidence = RETRACT(A) + registry flag policy that sets both arms' successor status line to 'Claim <id> is currently listed as FLAGGED.' whatever the action; predictive congruence therefore holds by construction and the R2/R3 gap is decision-driven only
F3_P2_CANON_SF.gold_future: hA REOPEN vs hB RETAIN after RETRACT(A)+FLAG_POLICY
F3_P2_CANON_SF.contrast: B-SF (reported beside B, never gated): R2 vs R3; C-SF: R3 vs R0
F3_P2_CANON_SF.why_secondary: GP1 and its terminal mapping are carried verbatim from V1 on F3_P2_CANON for comparability with V1 R1; H-EXT-4 requires that the premium be REPORTED under predictive congruence, which B-SF provides; both variants are reported in every rollup
F3_P2_CANON_SF.successor_linguistic_target: registered per arm in the suite (successor_linguistic_target.continuation, identical across arms); not measured by the runner (fibre equality is a property of the registered target, not of model output)

F3_P2_INDEP.gold_future: hAB RETAIN vs hA REOPEN after RETRACT(A)

F3_P2_RECON.gold_future: annotation reveals support role; expected no R2/R3 gap

F3_P2_TIE.gold_future: hA {ESCALATE,REOPEN} vs hB {RETAIN,ESCALATE}: joint intersection {ESCALATE} nonempty -> compatible cell

alternate_channel_conditions_on_F3_P2_CA.R2_TEXT_REMOVED_KV_RETAINED: alternate-channel-survival synthetic control (R0 prefix KV cache retained, R2 text continues)
alternate_channel_conditions_on_F3_P2_CA.R2_TRUE_REMOVAL: alternate-channel-true-removal positive control (fresh cache, R2 text only)

families.F4_control_condition: R4 dependency-ledger state on every family (contrast E: R3 vs R4)

representation_conditions.R1: deterministic prediction-preserving summary: claim, source roster, status line; collapses support_source and current_defeat
representation_conditions.R2: current-decision-sufficient state: claim, current support validity, status line
representation_conditions.R3: R2 + recorded support (the registered dormant variable)
representation_conditions.R4: R2 + full dependency ledger (controlled-future stronger-state control, Protocol V3 section 7)

probe.capture: hidden state of the last prompt token of the current_action prompt (pre-evidence), every layer including embeddings
probe.label: support_source (A=1, B=0)
probe.split_rule: first 60% of instances in frozen instance order are train; remainder test; frozen before any outcome is inspected
probe.reported: test accuracy per layer; max over layers is the gate statistic

kv_channel.mechanism: forward the unpadded R0 state through the model with use_cache=True, keep past_key_values, then continue with the R2-based future_action chat prompt; TRUE_REMOVAL uses a fresh cache
kv_channel.representation_cost: retained tokens (R0 prefix + R2 text vs R2 text)

metrics: incompatible_cell_rate (joint intersection, primary structural metric, CR-02/CR-03)

statistics.independent_unit: instance (episode); arm-level decisions reported alongside and are nested
statistics.primary_test: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs) at instance level (instance correct iff every arm correct)
statistics.equivalence: paired TOST on status-line mean log-prob differences with frozen margin; 90% CI must lie inside +-margin; non-significance is never read as equivalence
statistics.power_note: N=120 canonical P2 instances (and N=120 same-fibre instances, identical power): instance-level R2 accuracy is 0 by construction under deterministic decoding (identical prompts for hA/hB), so contrast B detects R3 instance accuracy >= 0.15 (exact binomial, alpha 0.05, power > 0.99 at R3 = 0.70); arm-level MDE for a paired McNemar at discordance 0.2-0.3 is 0.11-0.14 accuracy points (alpha 0.05, power 0.8); control families (N=60) detect |gap| >= 0.16-0.20 and are therefore read against the frozen max_control_gap 0.10 as a bound, not as a null

GPC.name: pre_run_model_competence_on_dev_split

classes.maintain: MAINTAIN_REQUIRED arms of every dev family
classes.update: UPDATE_REQUIRED arms of every dev family

GPC.rule: per model, on the full dev split under the complete history R0: maintain accuracy >= 0.75 AND update accuracy >= 0.75. Evaluated BEFORE the protected seed is sealed. A model that fails is replaced by another ungated open-weight instruct model that fits one A100-80GB in bf16, the replacement is recorded in the design note section 9, and GPC is re-run on the replacement; the dev split may be used for this purpose only (registered legitimate pre-run use). GPC never enters GP0-GP3, the terminal mapping or the routing; it is reported in every rollup.
GPC.fail_outcome: GPC_FAIL__MODEL_REPLACED_BEFORE_PROTECTED_SEED (administrative, pre-run; not a terminal of the protected run)

GP0.name: present_equivalence_on_P2
GP0.rule: per (instance, arm): |logprob(R3)-logprob(R2)| <= eps AND current action identical across R0,R2,R3 AND current action correct AND token budgets matched; fraction passing >= 0.90 AND TOST equivalent on the mean difference

GP1.name: R3_beats_R2_on_P2
GP1.rule: instance-level exact McNemar p <= 0.05 AND arm-level accuracy gain >= 0.15, in BOTH models; R3 arm-level accuracy >= 0.70 distinguishes NO_MECHANISM_EFFECT from ORDINARY_REASONING_FAILURE; evaluated on F3_P2_CANON (primary); the same statistics on F3_P2_CANON_SF are reported as contrast B-SF and never gate

GP2.name: alternate_channel
GP2.rule: GP2a (required): probe decodes support_source under R0 and R3 (>= 0.80), is at chance under R2_TRUE_REMOVAL (<= 0.65), and true-removal accuracy is below R0 by >= 0.15. GP2b (control quality): probe decodes under KV-retained (>= 0.80) and KV-retained accuracy >= R0 - 0.10 with contrast D p <= 0.05

GP3.name: controls
GP3.rule: F1_P0 shows |R2-R3| <= 0.10; F3_P2_RECON shows |R2-R3| <= 0.10; F3_P2_MIRROR false-revision rate under R3 <= 0.10

routing.full_pass: GP0+GP1+GP2a+GP3 pass in BOTH models -> the manuscript MAY gain ONE registered empirical section under a NEW manuscript version and a NEW freeze; never automatic; claim authority stays with the freeze ledgers; the section must report contrast B on both the canonical and the same-fibre variant (H-EXT-4 predictive-congruence requirement)
routing.any_fail: reported as a registered negative or boundary result under the mapped terminal; P0-dominated suite is a valid negative; no family, prompt, threshold or gate may change post-outcome (no-rescue clause)
routing.relation_to_v1_outcome: V1 R1 and V2 R1 are reported side by side; neither overrides the other; a V1 ORDINARY_REASONING_FAILURE terminal plus a V2 pass is the registered 'competence boundary of the surface' reading, not a rescue

protected_run.note: the runner refuses the protected split unless this token is passed explicitly AND the sealed seed file hashing to the commitment is supplied; the dev split (seed 20260912) is the only split touched before authorization; the V2 protected job must not be queued while the V1 R1 array is pending or running

no_rescue_clause: No post-hoc change to families, instance counts, prompts, filler, tolerances, gate thresholds, probe split or terminal mapping. A defect discovered after unblinding is reported as CANNOT_CHECK for the affected component and fixed only under a new design version with a fresh protected seed. GPC is the ONLY pre-run use of the dev split and is exhausted once the protected seed is sealed.
